g.text: +draft(question, language, sources : HandoffSource [*], request_id, top_office, office_id) : HandoffResponse
choose_office(): deterministic. Keywords of the rule
table are counted per office; a tie goes to the office
of the best retrieved passage, then to rule order;
no match = out of scope, no draft.
draft(): formal Italian text with placeholders for the
student's data. Nothing is ever sent (sent = false).
language, prompts, LLM providers, verifier, answer service
Pydantic models of the API contract
